aboutMeText1: I am Roziya Tukhtayeva, a Software Engineer based in Andijan, Uzbekistan, specializing in Frontend Architecture and QA Automation.
aboutMeText2: Backed by startup experience, I build scalable, high-performance web applications focused on code quality and system reliability. By combining dynamic UI development with robust end-to-end testing, I bridge the gap between seamless user experience and software stability. I design frontend systems for long-term maintainability, ensuring every release is production-ready. Check out my work in the projects section below.
